name: techdella/author-box
title: Author box
description: E-E-A-T byline at the end of a post: the named author (td_team profile: role, bio, photo, LinkedIn), the reviewer and the last-reviewed date (post fields reviewer, last_reviewed). Never a generic 'TechDella Team' byline.

item.author: Joanna Okedara-Kalu
item.bio: Founder & CEO of TechDella. Helps B2B companies get found on Google and in AI search.

techdella.help: Reads the current post: author → the td_team member linked to that user (wp_user field), reviewer (user field) and last_reviewed (date). Hidden when the author is not a named person. item is a preview-only example.
